offer_letter_generation.inclusion: Generate a complete offer letter from structured employee and role inputs.
offer_letter_generation.exclusion: Other document editing without an offer-letter contract.

court_form_filling.inclusion: Transfer case facts into a supplied court form.

schedule_planning.inclusion: Produce a schedule satisfying explicit constraints.
schedule_planning.exclusion: Calendar text normalization without constraint solving.

stock_data_visualization.inclusion: Transform stock data into the requested interactive visualization.
stock_data_visualization.exclusion: Generic chart styling without stock-data analysis.

dbscan_parameter_tuning.inclusion: Tune DBSCAN parameters against a supplied clustering objective.
dbscan_parameter_tuning.exclusion: Unrelated clustering or generic parameter search.

weighted_gdp_analysis.inclusion: Calculate weighted GDP measures from supplied economic data.

dependency_vulnerability_audit.inclusion: Audit dependency manifests for scoped vulnerabilities and produce evidence.

retail_exchange_resolution.inclusion: Resolve delivered-order return or exchange requests under retail policy.

airline_booking_change.inclusion: Change or cancel an existing airline reservation under policy.
airline_booking_change.exclusion: New booking without a change to an existing reservation.

telecom_connectivity_troubleshooting.inclusion: Diagnose and repair mobile data, roaming, or APN connectivity.
telecom_connectivity_troubleshooting.exclusion: Account billing and unrelated device configuration.

banking_product_application.inclusion: Select, apply for, or inspect a banking product for a verified user.
banking_product_application.exclusion: Generic knowledge answers without a product workflow.

pandas_dataframe_manipulation.inclusion: Implement a function whose reusable procedure centers on pandas DataFrame APIs.

numpy_numerical_computing.inclusion: Implement a function centered on NumPy array operations.
numpy_numerical_computing.exclusion: Pure Python numerical code without NumPy procedure transfer.

filesystem_path_operations.inclusion: Implement file discovery, path, directory, or filesystem operations.
filesystem_path_operations.exclusion: File formats where filesystem traversal is incidental.

matplotlib_visualization.inclusion: Implement a plotting function centered on Matplotlib APIs.
matplotlib_visualization.exclusion: Plots generated only through another primary library.

security_code_repair.inclusion: Inspect and repair or harden code against a concrete security failure.

office_document_automation.inclusion: Create or transform a constrained office document artifact.
office_document_automation.exclusion: Free-form prose without an artifact contract.

constrained_operations_planning.inclusion: Construct a plan or allocation satisfying explicit constraints and an objective.

energy_grid_optimization.inclusion: Optimize grid dispatch, unit commitment, power flow, or market allocation under physical and operational constraints.
energy_grid_optimization.exclusion: Generic control or energy-domain calculation without an optimization objective.
